question_stem:
A cuboidal block floats in a liquid with its base horizontal, as shown in Fig. 5.1.

{{figure:figure_5_1}}

Fig. 5.1

The base of the block is at a depth $h$ below the surface of the liquid.

The block is displaced downwards by a small distance and then released so that it oscillates.

Fig. 5.2 shows the variation with $h$ of the acceleration $a$ of the block.

{{figure:figure_5_2}}

Fig. 5.2

Fig. 5.3 shows the variation with $h$ of the kinetic energy $E_{K}$ of the block.

{{figure:figure_5_3}}

Fig. 5.3

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Determine the amplitude of the oscillations.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State what the line in Fig. 5.2 shows about the nature of the oscillations.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State **three** other quantitative conclusions that can be drawn from Fig. 5.2 and Fig. 5.3 about the block and its oscillations. Use the space for any working.

parts.label: (c)
